interpretation: 'None of the things that are imperishable simply is potentially simply (though nothing prevents it in some respect, as in quality or place); so they are all actually' (οὐθὲν ἄρα τῶν ἀφθάρτων ἁπλῶς δυνάμει ἔστιν ἁπλῶς (κατά τι δὲ οὐδὲν κωλύει, οἷον ποιὸν ἢ πού)· ἐνεργείᾳ ἄρα πάντα). Read as Aquinas reads it: each simply imperishable being is in act in substance. The parenthesis forbids reading 'all actually' as act in every respect; the eternal moved thing of the next sentences is in potency 'from where to where'.
